descriptions.preferred: The red tones of the leaves distinguish this cultivar as a form of Acer palmatum. The leaves have five or seven lobes and vary from 4 to10 cm long and wide. The lobes separate two-thirds to three-quarters of the way to the leaf base and are ovate to ovate-lanceolate with pointed tips Corvallis erly be named Acer palmatum f. atropurpureum. The original plant of this name was probably an excellent clone originating from the old nursery of Constant Wattez in Woudenberg, Netherlands (van Gelderen et al. 1994). It forms a well-branched tree 8-10 m tall. The leaves are mainly five lobed and a rich purple in the spring, which becomes deeper in early summer and turns to a brilliant scarlet in the fall. However, because many nurseries have used this name for any red-leaved seedling selection, it has become so diluted as to be meaningless. rhs.description: A small tree of bushy habit, with bronze-crimson leaves divided into about 7 lobes, and becoming brilliant red in autumn. Inconspicuous red-purple flowers in spring may be followed by winged, purple fruits

attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this amoenum group have large, palm-shaped leaves with finely-toothed edges

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 from late autumn to midwinter only
care.propagation: Propagate by layering in autumn, grafting in late winter or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市或庭院花园、乡村风或自然式花园
attributes.hort_group_description: 此 amoenum 类群中的 Acer 品种具有大型掌状叶，叶缘具细锯齿。

care.cultivation: 宜栽于保水且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风位置。半阴环境下叶色表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦边。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪第 1 组：仅限在晚秋至仲冬期间进行。
care.propagation: 可于秋季行压条繁殖，于晚冬进行嫁接，或采用软枝扦插繁殖。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感 Verticillium wilt、槭树叶灼病和蜜环菌。

rhs_zh.description: 小型乔木，株形丛生紧密；叶片呈青铜绯红色，约分为 7 裂，秋季转为鲜艳亮红色。 春季开不显眼的红紫色花，之后可能结带翅的紫色果实

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种叶片的红色调表明它属于 Acer palmatum 的一个红叶类型。 叶片具 5 或 7 个裂片，叶长和叶宽约 4-10 cm。 裂片分裂深度约达叶基部的三分之二至四分之三，形状为卵形至卵状披针形，先端尖锐。 Corvallis 的记载中指出，它早期可被命名为 Acer palmatum f. atropurpureum。 这个名称最初对应的植株，很可能是一个优良克隆，来源于荷兰 Woudenberg 的 Constant Wattez 老苗圃（van Gelderen et al. 1994）。 它可形成分枝良好的树形，高 8-10 m。 叶片多为 5 裂，春季呈浓郁紫红色，初夏颜色加深，秋季转为鲜亮猩红色。 然而，由于许多苗圃将该名称泛用于任何红叶实生选株，这一名称已被严重泛化，几乎失去实际意义。 正是在这些红叶实生苗中，后来选出了许多优秀品种，如
